item.title: Inside the Mind of a Model: How AI Turns Meaning into Math
item.description:
When you type a sentence into ChatGPT or Copilot, you see words. The model sees geometry.

Every word, phrase, and line of code you enter becomes a point inside an invisible mathematical landscape—a high-dimensional map where meaning is measured not by grammar or logic, but by distance.

This post explores how that landscape works, why it gives AI its uncanny sense of context, and how you can visualize it using tools like Python or MATLAB.
If you’d like a more conceptual introduction to how AI “reads” code, start with How AI Reads Code: What Large Language Models Actually Understand .
